verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy question for a 2FA app, so the axis applies. The pack never mentions telemetry, analytics, crash reporting, or a usage-tracking toggle, or states that none is collected. Offline 'Use without backups' mode and end-to-end encryption are adjacent privacy features, not a documented way to opt out of telemetry.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
